title: Exercise automatic reconnect qualification through the production monitor with concurrent verify and cancellation
outcome: Production monitor-driven reconnect tests cover ownership and availability during concurrent explicit verification, stop/cancellation, and persistence settling, without live hosts or providers.
acceptance: A deterministic test drives the real central monitor or runtime path through fresh reconnect qualification, including first-probe timing and a stop during an in-flight qualification, and asserts owned cleanup without granting an old lease.
Concurrent explicit verify and automatic qualification and a temporary durability hold are exercised with phase controls; existing identity, key, enrollment and quarantine fences remain enforced.
